# Solarpunk Foundry

Compact LLM context index for this repository.

Last updated: 2026-08-24
Last verified: 2026-08-24 — every path below was confirmed present in the
working tree on that date.

## What this repo is

`madfam-org/solarpunk-foundry` is MADFAM's PUBLIC ecosystem contract hub
(Lane B): the ecosystem map at a platform-public level, the cross-repo
conventions, the `@madfam/*` shared packages, the port registry, and local
dogfooding scaffolds. It ships no application deployable.

It is NOT the operational source of truth. That is the PRIVATE `internal-devops`
repo (Lane A), which is the only allowed home for node identity, IPs, hardware
and capacity figures, costs, secret paths, incident internals, break-glass
procedures, and the authoritative domain map and repo registry.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions. Start here.
- `README.md` — front door: what this repo is and is not, how the lanes divide,
  the platform map, the cross-repo conventions, and current honest status.
- `ECOSYSTEM.md` — standalone ecosystem map, sanitized production topology, and
  the Enclii CLI reference.
- `MADFAM.md` — the fuller per-platform master reference.
- `llms-full.txt` — durable full-context map and operating contract.
- `AI_CONTEXT.md` — package and registry quick reference.
- `CLAUDE.md` — compatibility redirect to `AGENTS.md`. Not a policy file.

## Evidence standard (applies to anything you write here)

Every factual claim carries its source and the date that source was last
verified. Distinguish verified / documented-but-unverified / aspirational.
Never invent verification: you cannot probe production from this repo, so if the
newest source says 2026-08-24, write "last verified 2026-08-24" — not "live",
not "currently". Where you cannot establish something, say so and name what
would settle it. No marketing language, no invented metrics.
`docs/PORT_ALLOCATION.md` is the model to copy.

## Cross-repo conventions (full statements in README.md §IV)

- Auth: Janua OIDC, RS256 verified against the JWKS at
  `https://auth.madfam.io/.well-known/jwks.json`. HS256 is fail-closed since the
  2026-04-23 audit. Janua is single-issuer per deployment.
- Billing and entitlements: Dhanam. Read via API; no local mirror.
- LLM inference: Selva's OpenAI-compatible `/v1` at
  `https://inference.selva.town` (moved off `nexus-api` on 2026-07-07). No
  direct provider calls from service code.
- CORS: explicit allowlist per service. Wildcards banned.
- Deploys: Enclii is the control plane. GitOps — ArgoCD pulls; nothing pushes to
  the cluster; self-heal reverts live edits.

## Shared packages

Fifteen `@madfam/*` packages under `packages/`, intended for the private
`npm.madfam.io` Verdaccio registry (which runs from the `enclii` repo, not this
one), plus one tombstone — `ls packages | wc -l` returns 16. `@madfam/ui` was
RETIRED on 2026-09-05 and is a tombstone directory with no source.
`@madfam/tsconfig`, `@madfam/eslint-config` and `@madfam/prettier-config` are the
shared configs the repo adopts itself; they are publishable-shaped and not
published. Full table with versions: `AI_CONTEXT.md`.

- `packages/ecosystem-banner` — `@madfam/ecosystem-banner`, landing-page ticker
- `docs/ECOSYSTEM_BANNER.md` — banner + footer contract (public-safe)

## Key documents

- `docs/PORT_ALLOCATION.md` — port scheme, honestly labelled aspirational
- `docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md` — public-repo boundary checklist
- `docs/OPERATIONAL_REDIRECTS.md` — where operational content moved to
- `docs/LICENSING_STRATEGY.md` — per-repo license rationale (matrix is stale;
  see README.md §V for what the LICENSE files actually say)
- `docs/JANUA_INTEGRATION.md` — wiring Janua into a service
- `docs/DOGFOODING_GUIDE.md` — local dev setup
- `docs/CROSS_REPO_NAVIGATION.md` — where to find things across the ecosystem
- `docs/architecture/SYMBIOSIS.md` — the platform-relationship contract
- `templates/HONEST_STATUS_SCORECARD.md` — the status-reporting template

Two trees are under review and should not be treated as current: `docs/runbooks/`
and `infrastructure/`. Both describe a pre-k3s Docker-Compose architecture that
production no longer uses, and both are owned by a separate remediation pass.

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only, and any
such use must record actor, reason, target service and environment, commands,
result, and the follow-up Enclii adapter gap or incident link.

Secret handoff: `enclii secrets intake`. Never paste credentials in agent chat.
Never write Vault paths or secret names with retrieval detail into this repo.

Live up/down state comes from `status.madfam.io`, never from a document in this
repo.

## Boundary

Public repo. Node hostnames, public IPs, hardware models and capacity figures,
the Cloudflare tunnel identifier, cost and procurement data, Vault paths, raw
break-glass procedures, and incident evidence trails must never appear here.
Canonical policy: `internal-devops/docs/repo-boundary-contract.md`
(last updated 2026-06-14).
